Today is Gold Star Children's Day, and I'm so glad the Senate passed our bipartisan resolution in time to recognize it.

These kids grow up carrying the weight of losing a parent who gave everything for this country. They deserve to know this country will always stand behind them. Gold Star children deserve to know their parents' service will never be forgotten and that this country will always stand behind them.
posts.summary: Honors Gold Star children, affirms government support for military families

Every kid deserves a positive role model in their lives. But too many, especially boys, don't have one. We need more people to step up.  
  
I introduced two bills to boost recruitment of men into classrooms and national service. When more people serve their communities, everyone benefits.

posts.text: Great meeting with teachers and community leaders in Phoenix to pack school supplies for students heading back to class. We also talked about my new initiative to get more men involved in mentoring and serving their communities. Boys especially benefit from strong male role models, and these educators see every day the difference that kind of support can make.
